message:
We all want to feel a little more prepared, don’t we? It’s like having a warm blanket ready for those chilly nights — comforting and reassuring. This resource has some great safety skills to share in our family group chat, sparking conversations about how we can support each other in different situations. 

Let’s take a few moments to explore these together, maybe even plan a fun family safety night to practice a few skills. After all, being prepared is a team effort! 🌟
